fact: The flumph floats and speaks directly into the minds of the party.

fact: The party sees a stolen red dragon egg being subjected to cruel experiments in the vision.

source_quote: One small sprout stands apart from the rest, its movement not nearly as frantic

subject: myconids

fact: The party decides to avoid the fungal creatures for now and flag them for their contacts.
